title: nf-core/genomeqc pipeline parameters
description: A pipeline to compare multiple genomes and annotations

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/genomeqc/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

pipeline_mode_options.title: Pipeline mode options
pipeline_mode_options.description: General options that control which parts of the pipeline run.

container_engine.description: Container engine used to launch the interactive Shiny app. Only 'docker' and 'podman' are supported - Singularity/Apptainer does not work.

groups.description: A string with NCBI taxonomic groups of the assemblies. Can be a comma-separated list.
groups.help_text:
Only specify the groups if you are having problems downloading the assmeblies. Otherwise, the default value should work for any type of organism.
Available options: all, archaea, bacteria, fungi, invertebrate, metagenomes, plant, protozoa, vertebrate_mammalian, vertebrate_other, viral.

busco_lineage.description: A flag to set the busco lineage.

busco_lineages_path.description: A flag to set the BUSCO lineages directory (optional)

busco_config.description: A path to a BUSCO config file (optional)

min_buscos.help_text: Threshold for BUSCO count table: counts how many sequences in each assembly have at least this many Complete BUSCOs.
min_buscos.description: Minimum number of Complete BUSCOs a sequence must have to be counted as significant ortholog-containing sequences.

skip_busco.description: Skip BUSCO. If run on genome only, it will also skip orthofinder.

gxdb.description: Path to FCS-GX contamination screening database.

gxdb_manifest.description: Path to FCS GX contamination screening database

ramdisk.description: Path to RAM-backed tmpfs or ramfs location to store FCS-GX database
ramdisk.help_text: This parameter is optional, but settinng this directory will make contamination screening significantly faster.

save_cleaned_genome.description: Save cleaned genome after decontamination with FCS-GX

save_cleaned_adaptor.description: Save cleaned genome after adaptor removal with FCS-GX

ortho_version.help_text: Use 'v2' on arm64 (Apple Silicon) hosts, where OrthoFinder v3 does not work.

save_longest_isoform.description: Publish longest protein isoform fasta files.

tidk_options.title: TIDK options
tidk_options.description: Options for telomere identification with TIDK.

repeat.description: DNA string for tidk motif search

tree_summary_options.title: Tree summary options
tree_summary_options.description: Options for the summary tree plot.

tree_scale.description: Modifies scale of the tree plot in the tree summary, default value is '0.0005'. Useful if tree tips overlap with the concatenated plots. Very sensitive, increase/decrease by two-fold.

tree_margin.description: Tree's right margin size for the non-circular layouts.

tree_style.description: Tree layout style for the tree summary plot.
tree_style.help_text: 'roundrect' draws rounded branches (default), 'ellipse' draws curved branches with node points, 'rectangular' reproduces the legacy look with dotted leader lines, and 'circular' draws a fan tree with each summary statistic as a concentric coloured ring and a numbered assembly key. In circular mode the same stats as the default layout are available (sequence number, genome size, N50, gene number, genome and protein BUSCO completeness, FCS-GX contamination, etc.), each toggled independently via --skip_stats.

circular_rings.description: Circular layout only: which summary stats to draw as rings.
circular_rings.help_text: Comma-separated, ordered (inner->outer) list of stat keys, or 'all' to show every available stat. Unset uses a curated assembly/annotation-quality default (sequence number, N50, genome BUSCO, protein BUSCO, FCS-GX contamination). Keys: ch_plot, len_plot, n50_plot, gene_plot, busco_gen_plot, busco_prot_plot, fcs_plot, nseqs_plot, ortho_plot.

quality_preset.description: Circular layout only: phylogenetic-group thresholds used to score the quality (traffic-light) rings.
quality_preset.help_text: Quality rings (sequence count, N50, BUSCO completeness/duplication, FCS-GX contamination) are scored Good/Warn/Poor against these thresholds. 'generic' is deliberately lenient. The N50 and sequence-count cut-offs are clade-dependent starting points and should be tuned per project; the FCS-GX contamination cut-offs are fixed across presets.

quality_thresholds.description: Circular layout only: override individual --quality_preset cut-offs.
quality_thresholds.help_text: Comma-separated 'metric=good:warn' pairs, e.g. 'n50=2e6:5e5,seq_number=500:5000'. Metrics: busco_complete, busco_duplicated, n50, seq_number, fcs_noncontam. Direction (higher/lower is better) is fixed per metric, so only the cut-off values are given. Metrics not mentioned keep the selected preset's cut-offs.

show_ring_values.description: Circular layout only: print each value on its ring.
show_ring_values.help_text: Adds a redundant, non-colour-only encoding (important for accessibility, since the traffic-light rings otherwise rely on colour alone). Best suited to small trees.

skip_plots_genome_anno.description: Skip these stat plots in the genome and annotation tree plot.
skip_plots_genome_anno.help_text:
Comma-separated list of plot types to skip. Valid values: ch_plot, nseqs_plot, ortho_plot, len_plot, gene_plot, n50_plot, busco_gen_plot, busco_prot_plot, te_plot, fcs_plot
ch_plot: Number of sequences
len_plot: Genome size and GC content
gene_plot: Number of genes and overlapping genes
n50_plot: N50
busco_gen_plot: Genome BUSCO completeness
busco_prot_plot: Protein BUSCO completeness
te_plot: TE composition
fcs_plot: FCS-GX contamination

skip_plots_genome_only.description: Skip these stat plots in the genome only tree plot.
skip_plots_genome_only.help_text:
Comma-separated list of plot types to skip. Valid values: ch_plot, nseqs_plot, ortho_plot, len_plot, n50_plot, busco_gen_plot, te_plot, fcs_plot
ch_plot: Number of sequences
len_plot: Genome size and GC content
n50_plot: N50
busco_gen_plot: Genome BUSCO completeness
te_plot: TE composition
fcs_plot: FCS-GX contamination

save_intermediate_files_options.title: Save intermediate files
save_intermediate_files_options.description: Options to publish intermediate files that are not saved by default.

save_sorted_seqs.description: Publish sorted fasta genome files from seqkit.

save_validated_annotation.description: Publish gff files validated by AGAT.

save_assembly.description: Publish genomes and/or annotations of user-supplied RefSeq IDs.

save_extracted_seqs.description: Publish extracted protein fasta files by GFFREAD.

save_filtered_seqs.description: Publish filtered fasta genome files from seqkit.

te.description: TE annotation method to run. Use 'hite' for HiTE or 'repeatmasker' for the full RepeatMasker pipeline. Omit to skip TE annotation. 'hite' does not support -profile conda/mamba  - use `-profile docker`, `-profile singularity`, or `-profile podman` instead.

is_plant.description: Set to true for plant genomes (passed to HiTE).

curated_lib.description: Path to a curated repeat library for HiTE.

famdb_library.description: Path to pre-staged famdb h5 partition file(s). Accepts a single file path or a glob pattern (e.g. '/path/FamDB*'). Alternative to downloading via RM_db.

famdb_lineage.description: Taxonomic lineage to filter repeat families from famdb (e.g. 'hymenoptera'). Omit to export all families.

run_repeatmodeler.description: Run de novo repeat discovery with RepeatModeler before masking. Disabled by default — RepeatModeler typically requires 24 CPUs and 24–48 h per genome. When false, only the curated famdb library is used.

repeatmasker_speed.description: RepeatMasker sensitivity/speed mode. 'default' is most sensitive; 'q' (quick) is ~5x faster; 'qq' (rush) is fastest with lowest sensitivity.

RM_download_db.description: Download h5 partition files from the URLs specified in RM_db.

RM_db.description: List of URLs to DFAM h5 partition files to download.

te_clusterer.description: Clustering tool used to dereplicate the repeat library before RepeatMasker. 'mmseqs' uses MMseqs2 easy-cluster; 'linclust' (default) uses MMseqs2 easy-linclust (linear time, less sensitive); 'cdhit' uses CD-HIT-EST.

te_cluster_identity.description: Minimum sequence identity threshold (0.0–1.0) for repeat library clustering. Passed as -c to CD-HIT-EST and --min-seq-id to MMseqs2.

te_cluster_coverage.description: Minimum alignment coverage threshold (0.0–1.0) for repeat library clustering. Passed as -aS to CD-HIT-EST and -c (with --cov-mode 1) to MMseqs2.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
